policy: Glamsterdam progress follows the twenty officially scheduled core EIPs in EIP-7773. All twenty project entries now have Complete implementation labels, with current EIP-7495 qualification in PR159. The frozen development ledger remains separate. EIP-8025 and canonical Ethereum guest research remain later proposals without an official fork assignment.

items.title: Independent Frame / FOCIL agreement
items.current: Native paired signed Frame and inclusion-list controls are delivered. The fresh CL used a synchronized EL.
items.remaining: Qualify an independent client using the same seven-field Frame/Bogota contract, plus alternate-peer recovery and redundant BN / remote-signer paths.
items.doneWhen: Independent state and receipt roots, signed verdicts, late join and restart agree under the adopted contract.

items.title: Dora production consumers
items.current: Decoder and inclusion-list display work do not establish the full production consumer migration.
items.remaining: Finish and qualify epoch, receipt and statistics consumers, schema migration, missed-event recovery, pruning and persisted rebuild.
items.doneWhen: Real consumer reads survive competing roots, Req/Resp recovery and restart before retained-view adapters are retired.

items.title: Workload and paymaster service cutover
items.current: The pinned local paymaster ABI and paired sponsored/blob controls are delivered.
items.remaining: Qualify ordinary, delegated and sponsored services against the selected protocol and actual deployment consumers.
items.doneWhen: Real service settlement, fees, receipts, retry and restart agree at declared source pins.

items.title: Later optional execution proofs and canonical Ethereum STF guest
items.current: EL #156 delivers real RV32IM program-execution receipts, complete statement binding and native asynchronous prove/verify consumers. The fixed-output STF adapter fixture is not an Ethereum STF implementation.
items.remaining: Complete the Ethereum STF guest, authenticated execution witnesses and payload-bound optional-proof lifecycle in later rounds; this work is outside official Glamsterdam scope.
items.doneWhen: Authenticated witness-backed Ethereum execution matches independent roots, and payload-bound optional proof production, verification, signed propagation and recovery pass at pinned schemas. Normal payload validation remains authoritative.

items.title: Public binary-state contract and recovery
items.current: Private binary overlay/conversion controls do not define a public compatible layout.
items.remaining: Agree layout, addressing and witness rules; qualify authenticated recovery and resource bounds.
items.doneWhen: Independent clients agree on roots, witnesses and persisted recovery under the chosen public contract.

items.title: PQ validator keys, transactions and sampling
items.current: PQ primitives and private provider/transaction controls are narrower than a public protocol.
items.remaining: Define validator-key lifecycle, public signing/sampling contracts and independent implementation vectors.
items.doneWhen: Key registration, rotation, revocation, replay rejection and live consumers agree across independent implementations.

items.title: Proof, native-rollup and finality consumers
items.current: Native rollup transition/withdrawal helpers use simulated hash conditions; these are not real rollup proof acceptance.
items.remaining: Adopt compatible execution, proof and consensus contracts; connect independent verifiers and actual deciding consumers.
items.doneWhen: State transitions, withdrawals, fees and finality pass independent end-to-end positive and rejection controls.

currentConformanceReview.title: Current conformance review
currentConformanceReview.summary: The 20/20 count describes retained implementation labels. Current-spec corrections now pass pinned-source qualification; the linked reviews record their delivery and merge state.
currentConformanceReview.detail: All 43,790 native EL cases pass, covering 52,620 block checks: 45,221 accepted and 7,399 expected rejections. All 12,195 selected CL full-node and compatibility cases pass with crypto modes separately recorded. Real BLS/KZG wire consumers and the combined native node build pass. Lighthouse corrections are merged into eth2030; EL delivery is preserved in the master-targeted reviews.
currentConformanceReview.boundary: Original-04 attribution remains unconfirmed. 48h/scale and Lodestar upstream approval remain excluded, not passed. EIP-8025 and a full Ethereum STF guest remain later work.
